# Power Champion

> Power Champion (https://powerchampion.ai) is an AI platform by Power Champion Investment Limited: one OpenAI-compatible API at b300.powerchampion.ai for open AI models covering text, vision, images, speech, and retrieval — with published API pricing, prepaid credits, integration tools, and dedicated NVIDIA HGX GPU infrastructure for enterprise AI workloads. Site languages: English, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어.

Optional: the extended reference with the full model catalog (rates per model), prepaid packs, and the 14-section API endpoint summary is at https://powerchampion.ai/llms-full.txt.

## Company

- Legal name: Power Champion Investment Limited — founded 2018, Taipei City, Taiwan
- Address: 7F, No. 38-1, Section 1, Ren'ai Rd, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City 100, Taiwan
- Tel: +886 2 2396 0605 · Email: info@powerchampion.org
- Capacity context is counterparty-reported (Azio AI Holdings SEC Exhibit 99.1, July 9, 2026): expected initial hosting capacity of approximately 3.1 MW with potential expansion up to 12 MW. This does not state that Power Champion has completed deployment or owns a data centre.

## API Platform

- OpenAI-compatible API at b300.powerchampion.ai: chat, embeddings, image, and speech endpoints; prepaid balance, one key, pay per use.
- [Model catalog](https://powerchampion.ai/models): open AI models for text, vision, images, speech, and retrieval with published API rates.
- [Pricing](https://powerchampion.ai/pricing): published API rates for tokens, images, and audio, with prepaid credit options and a workload cost calculator.
- [API playground](https://powerchampion.ai/playground): test model API requests with your own key and inspect responses and token usage.
- [Console](https://powerchampion.ai/console): check your prepaid API balance with your key.
- [Integrations](https://powerchampion.ai/integrations): model-specific Python, JavaScript, and cURL examples.
- [Docs](https://powerchampion.ai/docs) · [API reference](https://powerchampion.ai/docs/api)
- [Platform](https://powerchampion.ai/platform) · [Compare models](https://powerchampion.ai/compare) · [Service status](https://powerchampion.ai/status)

## AI Agents

- [Agent platform](https://powerchampion.ai/agent-platform): turn CSV data, proposals and meeting notes into editable Word reports, decision briefs and action lists.
- [AI assistants & custom agent services](https://powerchampion.ai/agents): instruction-based assistants for support, research, content, and coding; custom agents built around company knowledge, systems, and workflows.

## GPU Infrastructure

- [Dedicated GPU infrastructure](https://powerchampion.ai/infrastructure): dedicated NVIDIA HGX GPU capacity (H100/H200, HGX H200, L40S/A100) on NVIDIA HGX reference architecture with 400G/800G InfiniBand networking, bare-metal deployments, isolated enterprise clusters, and custom IDC deployment.
- Services: serverless GPU compute, always-on GPU instances, S3-compatible storage, model training, enterprise clusters.
